The club room looked quieter than usual that evening. Little by little, things began to change. The chat group has become an important part of daily life. Best of all, we meet up for coffee every Friday.

David thanked Leo for the honest advice. David is saving money to buy a ticket to Xi'an. David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, the old steam loco still runs on summer weekends.

David will take part in a baseball match in July. There are always more possibilities than we expect. People around David often share different ideas about the club room. In fact, he was ashamed of his mistake.

David wrote down every idea in a small notebook. At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. David usually spends the weekend reading at the supermarket. Spencer fixed my bike in less than an hour.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. On Saturday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. Leo always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
